aboutGame.title: What is Idle Breakout?
paragraphs: Idle Breakout is a browser-based incremental brick-breaker from developer Kodiqi. You buy and upgrade an arsenal of balls that bounce around an enclosed arena, automatically chipping away at numbered bricks while you idle. Cash from every destroyed brick is reinvested into more balls, higher damage, and faster fire rates.

Progression is endless: clear a stage, unlock tougher brick layouts with higher HP, and push toward boss levels that test your loadout. Prestige resets trade your current run for Black Bricks (BB), permanent upgrades that multiply every future run. Specialty balls like Plasma, Sniper, Scatter, Cannon, and Poison open up new clearing strategies as the numbers scale.

items.question: What is Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is a browser-based incremental brick-breaker from developer Kodiqi. You buy and upgrade balls that automatically destroy numbered bricks, then reinvest the cash into more damage, speed, and specialty ball types.

items.question: How do Idle Breakout codes work?
items.answer: Idle Breakout codes are encoded save-state strings rather than promotional vouchers. Importing a shared string replaces your local save with another player's progress, so export a backup of your own save before trying one.

items.question: Which balls should beginners buy in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Start with Basic Balls to build early income, then move into Plasma Balls for splash damage. Add Sniper and Poison Balls once brick health scales up and boss bricks appear.

items.question: When should I prestige in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Prestige in Idle Breakout when your balls take too long to clear a stage. Resetting converts your run into Black Bricks (BB), which buy permanent upgrades that speed up every future run.

items.question: Where can I play Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is a free browser game available on Kongregate and Coolmath Games, and it also runs in mobile browsers.
